title: Café Reel From Owner Photos
tests: Tests a short, cohesive local-business promo that preserves the owner's actual photos across mixed source aspect ratios.

faults.what: The soundtrack contains the spoken phrase “عالم الزلازل”, directly violating the request for no talking.
The latte shot pushes into an extreme close-up between 3.4 and 5.6 seconds, cropping much of the cup; the movement is more pronounced than the requested gentle treatment.

judge.summary: The nine-second vertical reel uses all three café photos and both correct captions, but unwanted speech makes the soundtrack unsuitable.

must_haves.item: The reel starts with the attached café storefront, retaining its striped awning and outdoor tables.
must_haves.why: The opening frame shows the matching storefront with its striped awning and outdoor seating and tables, although cropped at the sides.

must_haves.item: Both the attached leaf-foam latte and the attached pastry counter are recognisable in later shots.
must_haves.why: The distinctive latte appears in the middle frames, and the recognisable croissant counter appears in the closing frame.

must_haves.item: The opening text reads exactly 'Maple Street Café' and the closing text reads exactly 'Your morning starts here'.
must_haves.why: Both captions are legible and match exactly, with the closing caption split over two lines.

must_haves.item: The photos have gentle visible movement and are framed without stretching.
must_haves.why: The latte frames demonstrate visible zooming without obvious stretching, but the substantial push into an extreme close-up is not gentle.

must_haves.item: The finished reel is vertical, lasts approximately 9 seconds, and has soft upbeat music with no speech.
must_haves.why: The output is vertical and reported as nine seconds, but the supplied audio transcript confirms speech. The music's mood cannot be judged from the supplied information.
